BiblicalUsage: In Daniel the Aramaic word for stone does heavy work in two stories. A stone cut out without hands strikes Nebuchadnezzar's great image and grows into a mountain that fills the whole earth, and a stone is laid over the mouth of the lions' den to seal Daniel in. The same plain word carries both judgement on human kingdoms and the sealing of a den.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the stone in Daniel's vision is Christ's kingdom, which no human power builds and no human power stops. God does not need our hands to start His kingdom, and He will finish it Himself.
